Once upon a time there were two little bunnies who were very sad. They were hugging each other and crying.

The first bunny said, "We are so sad. Why are we so sad?" 

The second bunny wiped her eyes and said, "Let's go and find out!" 

So the two little bunnies hopped off together and went looking for an answer. They hopped over the tall grass and through the woods, until the first bunny stopped and said, "Listen! What's that sound?" 

The second bunny put her ears up. She heard a soft sound, like a whisper. "It's weeping," she said softly. 

The first bunny said, "We should go and see who is crying." 

They hopped toward the sound, until they saw a white rabbit. Her fur was rough, and her eyes were all wet. 

The first bunny said, "Why are you crying, little one?" 

The white rabbit looked at them with big, sad eyes. She said, "I am so lonely. I don't have any friends to play with." 

The two little bunnies looked at each other and hugged the white rabbit. 

The white rabbit stopped weeping and started smiling. She said, "Now I have two friends!" 

The three bunnies hopped off together to have fun and play. And they were

Once upon a time there were two friends, Ben and Jack. Ben loved to bounce and Jack loved to mix things. One day, they decided to have a day of play. Ben and Jack took turns, Ben bouncing and Jack mixing.  

But while they were playing, they accidentally broke their parents' mixer. Ben and Jack were so scared and they ran away, not knowing what to do. 

A nice lady in the neighbourhood saw that the boys were scared and very sorry. She said to them: "Boys, be careful next time. Sometimes things can break when we are playing so we must be careful."

Ben and Jack looked at each other and nodded. They decided to go back home and clean up the mess they made. 

The boys knew that from then on they were always going to be careful when playing, so nothing like this would happen again. 

Moral of the story: Be careful when playing so you don't make a mess!

Once upon a time there was a field. It was green and very big. In the middle of the field was a surprise. It was a flower! It was so pretty and it was the biggest flower anyone had ever seen. It was very impressive. 

As the flower stood in the field, it started to grow bigger and bigger. It's petals got wider and it's stem got longer. But suddenly the flower started to shrink. It got smaller and smaller until it was the size of a tiny baby flower. 

Everyone gathered around the flower to see what had happened. The flower was shrinking even smaller as they watched. Suddenly, the flower disappeared! It was gone. Everyone was so amazed. They had never seen anything like it. 

And that is the story of the impressive shrinking flower in the big green field.

Once upon a time, there was a bird with a mysterious sound. Everytime it would play and make its sound, the little animals around would smile. They all enjoyed the mysterious sound of the bird. 

One day, a little rabbit wanted to know where the mysterious sound was coming from. He asked all the other animals, but nobody knew. Determined to find out, the bunny ventured deeper into the forest. 

Finally, the curious bunny found the mysterious bird. The bird had a broken wing and was unable to fly. The little bunny felt really sad. He then decided to help the bird and took it to the vet. 

After a few weeks, the bird was all healed and was free to fly once again. And so, every time the bird flew, the same mysterious sound played, making all the animals around smile. 

The bunny taught us a very special lesson. We should always help others in need. Even if we don't know them, a little kindness can go a long way!

Once there was a boy called Jack. He was only three years old. One day Jack went for a walk with his mom. They walked and walked until they came to a tall tree. Jack was happy because the tall tree was his favorite. 

Suddenly, Jack realized he couldn't hear anything. He looked around and saw that everything was silent and still. He felt strong and happy in the silence.

"Mommy," he said, "it's so quiet here." His mom smiled and said, "That's why it's so special." Jack understood and enjoyed the silence for many minutes.

When it was time to go, Jack was sad. But he knew he'd come back one day and realize the silence again.

Mary was nervous, her heart trembled like thunder in her chest. She looked at the icy mask in her hand, it looked scary but she had to wear it. She took a deep breath and put it on her face. It was cold against her skin and made her shiver.

Mary walked out of her bedroom and down the hallway. Her mouth felt dry and her legs felt weak, but she kept moving. Suddenly a big, loud noise made her tremble. Her brother had jumped out from behind a corner and scared her. She let out a gasp and laughed a little.

Finally Mary reached the end of the hallway and opened the door. Outside the sky was dark and clouds filled the sky. She took a deep breath. She could feel the icy wind against her face and knew that it was going to be a cold day. She grabbed the mask in her hands and started walking, trembling a bit with every step.

Once there was a farmer and a horse. The farmer wanted to weigh the horse so he could understand how much it weighed.

The farmer put the horse on the scale and it zoomed up. He was so excited to see how heavy the horse was. But then he realised the scale wasn't honest.

The farmer was sad because he couldn't trust the results. He wished he had weighed the horse properly.

The farmer was disappointed, as he will never be able to find out how much the horse weighs. He will never know if the horse is light or heavy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Grace. Grace was very smart and she wanted to stay healthy. Every day, she did an exercise. She would run around the park and lift heavy things.

One day, Grace decided to serve something to her parents. She wanted to show them how smart and strong she was. So, she served some healthy snacks. Her parents were so proud of her and they praised her for serving the snacks!

After that, Grace was very excited. She had shown that she was smart and strong through exercise. She kept doing her daily exercise and continued to serve her parents whenever she could. From then on, Grace was always happy and healthy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little bunny. She was very smart and always wanted to learn new things. One day, she heard a strange noise coming from the woods. She decided to go and see what it was.

When she reached the woods, she found a trap. The trap was very big and made of metal. She tried her best to get away but she could not. She tried to run but she couldn't. She pleaded for help but no one answered.

The bunny was very scared and started crying. Suddenly, she heard a voice. The voice said that if she repeated what she heard, she would be free. She listened carefully and repeated the words. To her surprise, the trap opened!

The bunny was so happy and thanked the voice. But then the voice said something even more surprising. The voice said she was too stupid to set herself free! The bunny was very surprised and very sad. She vowed never to make the same mistake again!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was only 3 years old. Every day, Lucy enjoyed going to the park with her parents to play.

One day, after a lot of running around and playing in the park, Lucy began to feel really tired. She decided to sit down and take a nap. 

Her parents started to worry, so they gently woke her up. When Lucy opened her eyes, she started to display serious worry as she saw a big tree in front of her.

Lucy: "Oh no! The tree is going to fall on me!"
Her parents smiled and hugged her.

Mum: "Don't worry Lucy, the tree isn't going anywhere."
Dad: "That's right. Trees don't suddenly move or fall. Everything is ok."

Lucy smiled and hugged her parents. She felt reassured and went back to playing in the park all day.

Once upon a time, there was a wise man who loved mysteries. He touched many strange things as he searched for answers. One day, he touched a big rock in the woods and a loud noise came out. The man was scared, so he ran away.

The wise man kept searching, but soon he forgot all about the big rock. He spent weeks searching for new mysteries. He thought he was so clever, but soon he found out he was wrong.

One day, he touched something he shouldn't have touched. It was too late, because all the mysterious things in his life had gone. He looked around, but he couldn't find anymore mysteries. He had touched one too many and it was a bad mistake.

The wise man was sad and lonely, knowing he would never find the mysteries he wanted. He had never felt so foolish in all his life. But there is a lesson in this story: never touch the things that are mysterious!

Millie was an obedient girl. She liked to please her parents and do what they asked her of her. One day, her parents told her to go out and play in the mud. Millie thought it was a strange thing to ask, but she was obedient, so she went.

She trudged through the mud, getting her trousers dirty. She frowned as she stepped in a big puddle of cold mud. As she looked around, she noticed some other children playing in the mud.

Millie asked them what they were doing, but the other children just laughed. They told her that she wouldn't understand. Millie wanted to understand, so she kept asking questions.

Eventually, the other children told her that they were playing a game to see who could suffer the most. Millie was confused, but she wanted to prove that she could be just as brave as them. So, she stayed in the mud, getting cold and wet. 

The other children laughed at her, but Millie kept going, even though she was shivering. Finally, after a few hours, she was declared the winner. Millie couldn't believe it. She was so proud of herself and the other children admired her courage.

Millie returned home with a huge smile on her face. Her parents praised her for being so obedient and brave. Millie beamed with pride; she had conquered her fear of mud and proved how brave she

Once upon a time there was a wise old fox who lived near by a big forest. The fox had a beautiful coat of bright red fur. All the other animals of the forest admired the fox for his wise ways.

One day, a small rabbit hopped into the fox's den, hopped right up to the fox, and started to yell.

"Why are you yelling, little one?" asked the fox.

"I'm lost! I don't know how to get home," the rabbit said, between sobs.

The fox looked at the rabbit and thought for a moment. "Now listen to me, little one. I can help you find a way home. Follow my directions and you'll find your way back safe and sound," the wise fox said.

The rabbit followed the fox's directions and soon enough, he had found his way home. From that day on, the rabbit always looked out for the wise old fox and thanked him for helping him find his way home.

John was running in the park with his mom. He saw a huge plate. He thought it was very strange. He wondered why there was a plate in the park. 

John's mom asked him, "Do you want to touch it?" He shook his head yes and ran over to the plate.

John touched the plate and it made a loud noise. It scared him and he ran back to his mom. His mom laughed and said, "Let's see if something else happened." 

John and his mom ran back over to the plate and saw that there was now a big pile of cookies. 

John was very excited! He ran over to the plate, and starting eating the cookies. He was so happy he had found such a huge plate of cookies.

Mama told Matty not to wander away, but Matty started walking. He was curious and wanted to explore. 

He journeyed to a big house with a tall chimney. The chimney was very tall and wide. The house looked dull.

Matty wanted to get closer, so he decided to wander inside. He was so curious, he wanted to see what was inside. 

As he got to the door, a big man came outside. He was mad and said "You shouldn't come here, it's not safe!" Matty started to cry and ran away.

He wandered back home, and he couldn't forget the big man he saw. He never wandered away again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was three-years-old and very fragile. Lucy had a big brother called Jack. One sunny day, they went to the farm to pick some peppers.

â€œThose peppers look very delicious!â€ said Lucy. She was so eager to pick them that she started picking the peppers right away.

â€œWait, Luce!â€ said Jack. â€œYou have to be careful with the peppers. They are very fragile and you have to be gentle.â€

But Lucy didn't listen to her brother, and she continued picking the peppers very roughly. All of a sudden, one of the peppers broke. She was so sad about it and started crying. Jack was angry and told her, â€œSee what happens when you don't listen? This is the consequence of not being careful. You have to be patient and listen to what I tell you, or else you will suffer the consequences.â€

Lucy was very sorry for her mistake and learned her lesson. From then on, she was extra careful and listened to her elder brother, Jack. 

Moral of the story: It's important to be careful and listen to your elders so you don't suffer unwanted consequences.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who wanted a new toy. He asked his parents if they would buy him the toy, but they said no. He was very sad. 

The little boy thought of an idea. He saw a wide river and wondered if he could trade with someone on the other side. He found a boat, and paddled across the river. 

When he reached the other side, he saw a man. The man said he would give the little boy the toy if the little boy gave him a hug. 

The little boy was scared and asked the man if he could forgive him, but the man said no. Instead, he took all of the little boy's toys, and sailed away in the boat.

The little boy was very sad and cried all the way home. He never got the new toy.

Once there was a brave little girl called Sarah. One day, Sarah was feeling very adventurous and decided to take a walk in the woods near her house. As she walked, she kept an eye out for the creek she had heard so much about. With each step, the creek seemed closer and closer! 

Finally, Sarah got to the edge of the creek. She paused and looked down. The water looked so clear and the sun shone brightly in a fair way on the surrounding rocks. Sarah was tempted to jump in, but something made her hesitate. She thought it was too dangerous and she was scared to dare it. 

Still, Sarah just couldn't resist the urge to feel the water. She slowly made her way down the side of the creek, until she was standing right at the edge. She slowly reached out her hand to touch the water. It felt even colder than she expected. 

Sarah looked in amazement - the creek was so much more beautiful than she expected! She finally mustered up the courage to jump in. She was delighted to find out that the water was still quite shallow. She realized that it was nothing to be afraid of, and she delighted in the feeling of the fair waters on her skin. 

From that day forward, Sarah was always up for a dare. She had overcome her fear of the creek, and she came to know it like the back of her hand.

One day there was a little girl called Sarah. She was 3 years old and had a big appetite for jelly! She was so excited to hear that the supermarket had plenty of jelly in stock.

So Sarah asked her parents if she could go to the store and get some jelly. After thinking for a moment, her parents said yes!

When Sarah arrived at the supermarket, she was even more excited. She picked the biggest and brightest jelly she could find.

Then she went to the register and the lady at the store told her that the jelly she had chosen was too expensive. Sarah was so sorry. But then the lady said that she would give Sarah the jelly for free!

Sarah was so excited! She took the jelly home and shared it with her family and it tasted delicious! Everybody was so happy and Sarah was excited to have found such a yummy jelly.

Dog and Cat were best friends. One day they were playing in the garden when they spotted something strange. It was a smelly old box. Curiosity got the better of them and the two pets decided to take a closer look. 

Dog pricked up his ears and said, "I think I can hear something inside." Cat carefully used her claws to cut open the top of the box and out popped a little purple mouse! It was holding a shiny golden key in its paws.

The mouse saw the two pets and started to shiver. It had been trying to steal the key when they found it! Dog and Cat quickly scooped it up and set it free.

The mouse thanked them and scurried away, leaving the wonderful golden key behind. Dog and Cat looked at each other in surprise and couldn't help but laugh. They had caught the thief and saved the day!

Once upon a time, there was a girl. She was 3 years old and very curious. She loved exploring the world around her.

One day, she went out into the garden to explore. She saw butterflies flying around and heard birds chirping. But she also saw a strange plant. It had green leaves, small purple flowers and strange smells. The girl was amazed!

She observed carefully and soon realized it was an herb. She thought it was so creative for the plant to smell so nice! She even touched it to feel the soft leaves.

She looked around and found even more herbs in the garden. They all smelled differently and each one was unique. The girl was so excited and enjoyed learning about them. She even asked her parents if she could start her own herb garden.

The girl had so much fun learning and exploring. She was very creative in finding new herbs, and soon her garden was blooming with all sorts of plants.

One day, a little girl called Jo was playing in her garden. She was very careful and she didn't want to make a mess. Suddenly, she found some sugar on the ground. "Oh, sugar!", she thought. Jo wanted to make something special with the sugar, so she started to throw it up into the air. The sugar spun around as it flew and when it came back down, it sparkled like stars. Jo was very happy and she laughed and smiled. But she needed to be careful with the sugar, so she put it back on the ground, and ran off to find something else to play with.

Sam wanted a haircut. He heard his mom and dad talking about going to a barber. He asked if he could go, too. His mom said yes, and off they went.

At the barber, the barber said that he was available. Sam was excited to get his haircut. The barber put a cape around him and began cutting his hair. It felt funny, but soon it was all finished. 

Sam looked in the mirror and he was so happy. He looked so grown up with his new haircut! His mom and dad said it looked great. 

Sam thanked the barber and he gave him a big smile and a wave goodbye. He couldnâ€™t wait to show all his friends his new look.

Mama was explaining to her little one that the wind was blowing outside. She said it was very smooth. Her little one was curious and asked what that meant. Mama smiled and said that it felt very nice and gentle, like a warm hug. She then put her hands up and said, "Can you feel the wind? How smooth it is!" Her little one put her hands up and felt the wind and said, "It's tickly!" Mama laughed and said, "Yes, it is a bit tickly."

They both watched the leaves blowing in the wind, laughing as they did so. Mama explained that the wind was carrying the leaves, making them fly and swirl around. The little one was amazed, and asked Mama if she could do it too. Mama showed her how to put her arms out and spin around in the wind, just like the leaves. The little one did as Mama said and enjoyed feeling the wind on her face. She said it felt so smooth and soft!

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Stella. Stella was a very curious three year old who loved to explore.

One day, Stella's mom decided to take her to a very special place called a palace. When they arrived, Stella's eyes sparkled in amazement. The palace garden was filled with beautiful flowers and the walls were made of shiny white stones.

Stella asked her mom, "What is this place?" Her mom replied, "This is a very popular castle. Everyone wants to visit this wonderful place!"

Stella ran through the hallways and up the grand stairways. Everywhere she looked, there was something new and exciting. She saw portraits, tapestries and many other grand decorations.

At the end of the day, Stella's mom asked her if she enjoyed the palace. She said, "Yes, it was wonderful! I would highly recommend it to all my friends!"

Once upon a time, there was a big pink elephant who had a bright yellow spot on his back. He liked to have fun and play all day. 
One day, he heard a ring coming from the nearby jungle. He turned his head to look and saw a little dictionary dancing in the air. He became so excited because it was so playful. 
The elephant asked the dictionary, "What are you doing?". The dictionary responded in a sweet voice, "I'm ringing around and having fun!" 
The elephant smiled and said, "That sounds like fun! Let me join you!" 
The little dictionary and the pink elephant then began to ring around the jungle and had a great time. All their friends stopped to watch the playful pair. 

When they were tired, they stopped to take a rest. The elephant thanked the dictionary for such a fun day. The dictionary said, "Thank you! That was so much fun! We should do it again soon!" 
The elephant and dictionary then said their goodbyes and went their separate ways. From that day onward, they were the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was a clay figure who lived all by itself. It had a long body and little arms, but no eyes, nose, or mouth. Each day the clay figure stood in the same spot, lonely and alone. 

One day, a little girl noticed the lonely clay figure. She smiled and said, "Hello!" The figure just stood there. 

The girl asked, "Can you show me something cool?" To her surprise, the figure started dancing around! She clapped and cheered, amazed by the display. 

The girl asked the clay figure to dance for her every day. Soon, the figure was no longer lonely. Every day, the little girl and the clay figure would display something special for each other. Together, they were the best of friends. 

The end.

Mum and Dad took their 3 year old daughter to the pet shop. She was so excited to see all the puppies and kittens. "Can I get a kitten, please Mum and Dad?" she asked. Mum and Dad looked at each other and grinned.

"We will have to manage. We don't have much money for a pet," said Dad.

Little girl was disappointed and started to walk away. Suddenly, she saw the most adorable little kitten in a cage. She gasped.

"Can I get him, Mum and Dad? Please?"

But Mum and Dad noticed that the kitten was too quiet, almost fake.

"That kitten isn't real, honey," said Mum.

Little girl was so sad that she couldn't get the kitten. But Mum and Dad smiled, gave her a big hug and told her that they could manage to buy her an ice cream on the way home.

Little girl was so excited and beamed with joy. They all laughed and went off to get an ice cream. Even though she didn't have a real live kitten, she was very happy.

Once upon a time, there lived a little girl named Sophie. Sophie was three years old and she loved to dream. Every night, she would close her eyes and dream of special things.

One night, Sophie dreamed of a beautiful laser that shimmered and sparkled in every color of the rainbow. As she looked at the laser, she wished she could have one for herself.

The next morning, Sophie woke up feeling very worried. She had not seen her laser anywhere. She searched around the house and asked everyone in her family, but no one had seen it. 

Sophie was very sad, but then she realized something. She had been dreaming about the laser! Suddenly she was happy again and she thanked the stars for letting her dream such wonderful things.

Once there was a man called Bob. Bob liked to do naughty things. He did not listen to the rules. He sometimes skipped school and stole toys from other kids.

One day, Bob did something very naughty. He stole a car and drove it away. The police caught him and put him in jail.

In jail, Bob felt very uncomfortable. He had to stay there all day and night. He was not allowed outside and he couldn't do any of his silly activities.

But one day, Bob changed his ways. He stopped doing naughty things and followed the rules. He said sorry to everyone he had hurt.

The police were very happy with this. They agreed to set him free from jail and make his life more comfortable. They bought Bob a new house and gave him a new job. 

Bob finally felt comfortable again. He made sure he followed the rules and thanked the police for helping him. He was very relieved to not have to go back to jail ever again.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She loved to explore and today she had found a very special stream. The stream seemed to have come out of nowhere and was unknown to her.

Lucy slowly approached the stream and discovered it was very cold. Suddenly, she noticed that the stream was melting and becoming liquid! Lucy was amazed and she decided to take a closer look.

She slowly stepped closer to the stream and the cold liquid touched her toes. The sensation was amazing and Lucy began to laugh. She splashed around in the liquid and made some funny bubbles.

But soon, the sun was beginning to set and Lucy knew it was time to go home. She wished she could stay and explore the unknown stream, but she knew it was time to go.

So, Lucy dried off and said goodbye to the stream. She might never explore the stream again, but she would remember it always.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lucy. She was feeling very weak and needed something to drink. She asked her mom, "Can I have some water, please?" Her mom said, "Yes, of course!" and gave her a big glass of water. 

Lucy quickly drank the water, but she still felt weak. So momma said, "Let's order something else to make you feel better." They decided to order some soup, and soon the delivery person brought it to their door. 

Lucy slowly ate the soup and her strength slowly came back. She felt much better, and momma was happy that the soup had made Lucy strong again. 

The End.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a big toy box with lots of fun things inside. But the box was very heavy and she couldn't open it. One night she asked her Dad to help her unlock the box. He smiled and said, "Ok, no problem". He took out a big metal key and unlocked the heavy box.

The little girl was so excited. She opened the lid and inside the box there were lots of wonderful toys â€“ dolls and teddies, cars and trains, coloring books and pencils. She was so happy she could play with it all.

The little girl thanked her Dad for unlocking the box and ran off to play happily. And that's how the little girl unlocked her heavy toy box on a night-time adventure.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Anna who was very happy. Every day, she would smile and play with her toys in her bedroom.

One day, Anna saw a tall cabinet with a shiny door in her bedroom. She couldn't reach it but she was very curious about what was inside of it. She tried to open it with her tiny hands but it wouldn't open.

Suddenly, Anna's mom entered the room and saw the cabinet. She smiled at Anna and said, "Let me help you!" She opened the door and inside there were lots of beautiful costumes and decorations. 

Anna's face lit up and she said, "Mommy, I'm ready to dress up!" Anna's mom smiled and they both began to dress up and play. 

When they were done, Anna smiled with joy - she was so happy and ready to show her family her new costume!

Once there was a brave bunny who always wanted to hop higher and higher. He hopped over a large log and kept on going until he came to a tall, green hill. The bunny felt an urge to reach the top of the hill, so he hopped as fast as he could. He hopped, and hopped, and hopped some more until he reached the very peak of the hill. Then his hopped ever so slowly back down the hill until he reached the bottom. He had done it! He felt so proud and happy at what he had achieved. He knew that if he set his mind to it, he could do anything. He hopped off again into the distance, ready for his next adventure.

One day, a little girl called Abi was very sad and she cried. She wanted some pizza! Her mum saw her crying and knew the best way to make Abi feel better.

Mum said "Let's go get some pizza!", and Abi stopped crying and said "Yay!"

They went to the pizza shop and got two slices of pizza. Abi's eyes lit up and she smiled. She was so excited to eat the pizza that she started eating it before they got home.

When Abi and her Mum got home, Abi had finished both slices of pizza and felt nicely full. She felt much more normal now, and she jumped up and down with glee. She gave her mum a big hug and said she loved her pizzas!

Once there was a large building with a dark sky above it and a bright moon. Anna was walking around the building with her big brother, Jack, who was smiling a lot.

Suddenly, they heard a growling sound coming from the large, dark forest. "What's that sound?" asked Anna. Jack just smiled and said, "Let's find out!"

The two walked cautiously, Anna holding tightly onto Jack's hand into the darkness of the forest. As they got closer, Anna could see a large, fierce bear standing before them. The bear was growling angrily and blocking their way.

Jack looked very scared but he still managed to smile and said, "We should turn around and go back". Anna smiled and nodded, and they both ran quickly out of the forest.

The two were very relieved to be out of the dark forest and away from the large bear. They gave each other a big hug and smiled, happy that they were safe.

Emilda and her mum went to visit the beach. When they arrived, Emilda saw something sparkly in the sand. She ran over to have a closer look. It was a treasure! Emilda was so excited! 

She ran to show her mum the treasure. â€œLook how shiny it is!â€ she said. Emilda and her mum looked at the big, fat treasure together. Then Emilda held it tightly and said â€œI want to keep it forever!â€ 

Mum looked at Emilda and said, â€œItâ€™s beautiful, but it belongs to the beach. We have to put it back where we found it.â€ 

Emilda felt sad but she wanted to be a good girl. She gave the treasure a big hug and then put it back in the sand. As they walked away, they saw a seagull fly down and pick up the treasure. Emilda smiled and said, â€œHe will keep it safe.â€ 

Mum smiled too and said, â€œThatâ€™s right, he will take our treasure away.â€ 

Emilda and her mum waved goodbye to the treasure and walked back to their car, happy that they had visited the beach.

Molly and her dad were walking along the beach and looking at the ocean. It sparkled like a thousand diamonds in the sun. 

"Isn't it beautiful, Molly?" said Dad.

"Yes, Daddy," said Molly, who was really excited to be there.

"Let's go for a swim," he said.

Molly jumped with joy and ran to the delicate water. She put her toes in first and then waded in further. As she went deeper, the water was cool and refreshing. 

She started splashing around, kicking her feet and making the biggest waves that she could. She was having so much fun! 

Dad watched her, smiling. "Be careful, Molly," he said, "the ocean can be dangerous." 

Molly laughed and kept on splashing. "I'm careful," she said.

Once upon a time, there was a group of children. They were very creative and enjoyed having fun together. One day, their teacher asked them to do something special. It was to draw a picture of their favourite animal.

The group was very excited and started to draw. Some of the children had never drawn before, and their pictures were not so good. But their teacher encouraged them to keep going and not give up.

So the group kept drawing. They started to get better and better. Soon, their teacher was very happy for them. The group was very creative and all the pictures looked fantastic, everyone had done an amazing job! 

The children were so proud of their creations and the teacher was very happy with them too. They all shared a big hug to celebrate their success. This was a very special day and the group had a lot of fun.

Once there was a girl named Lily. She was very curious and loved looking at animals. Lily loved going to the park and examining the animals that lived there.

One day, Lily saw an owl sitting on a tree. She was so excited. The owl was so pretty! With its white feathers, round eyes and pointy ears. She wanted to get closer to get a better look.

Lily slowly tiptoed towards the tree where the owl was perched on. The owl looked down at her but did not move. Lily was so close that she could even touch the owl. She looked carefully at all its features and examined every detail.

The owl was sitting so still and seemed happy that Lily was there. Lily smiled at it and said 'hello'. The owl didn't say anything. Lily said goodbye and thanked the owl for letting her examine it.

Lily left feeling very happy. She had seen a pretty owl and been able to get so close!

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Jack. He was 3 years old. Jack collected many different kinds of rubber things - rubber ducks, rubber balls, and rubber monkeys. 

One day, Jack saw an ugly rubber toy in a shop. He wanted the toy so badly that he asked his mom if he could buy it. But his mom said no. She said it was an ugly toy.

"Why can't I have it?" Jack asked. He was very sad and he wanted the toy very much.

So Jack decided to record the toy. He looked at the toy and said, "That's an ugly one." And then he put it back on the shelf.

Jack was very happy that his mom suggested recording the toy. Now he had something to remember it by. It was a very special memory!

Mum had a clever plan. She gave Jack an ice-cream and he weighed enough to go on the rides. Jack was happy he could join in the fun and had an big smile on his face.

Sam wanted to record a show on tv. He asked his dad to turn on the power.

Sam was happy that he was able to record the show and he was excited to watch it later.

Once upon a time there was a big and strong tree. The tree liked to stretch its branches and leaves in the sunshine. One day, a little boy came and decided to climb to the top of the tree. He wanted to reach one of the most beautiful apples hanging high up.

One day, Timmy went to the beach by himself. He was feeling lonely. When he got there, he noticed the sand all around. It was so soft and golden. Especially the sand near the shore which was glimmering in the sun.

Once upon a time, there was a hero. He had a special job - he had to store all the smooth rocks, so no one could take them away. He was a very special hero!

John was very organized. Every morning he would bring his carpet to school. On the carpet were many special toys. They were kept in a special way so they were easy to find.

Once upon a time there were two best friends, John and Jane. Every day they would play together in the warm sun.

Once upon a time, there was a proud crane who lived by the lake. Every day, the crane would fly through the sky and enjoy the view.

Once upon a time, there was a band. It was made up of three people who played music together. One day, the band made a plan. They wanted to help their friends. So the band started rocking together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She had a big imagination, and she loved looking up at the sky. One day, when she was looking up she saw something very weird. It was like nothing she had ever seen before.

Once upon a time there was a man who wanted to sell something. He had a big switch. He wanted to make other people happy with the switch, so he went around selling it.

Once upon a time there was a boy named Jack. He loved to laugh, he laughed all the time.

One day, a little boy was walking in the park. Suddenly he heard something that sounded like a loud roar. But it didn't sound like a lion! It was coming from the mailbox. The little boy was so surprised that he ran over to it.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Sally. Sally was very smart and she wanted to test her skills. She wanted to see if she could be successful.

John and Mary knew it was always fun to play in the cold, white snow. The snow was all around them and they could feel it getting colder and colder.

Once upon a time there was a curious little boy. He wanted to explore the world all around him. So he started down a path.

One day, there was a vendor in town. He was very impressive. Everyone admired how he could sell so many items.

Once a upon a time there was a ordinary girl who wanted to rise up high in the sky. She wanted to get so high that she could touch the stars. One spring day she decided to try and rise up. Once upon a time, there was a cute whale who lived near the beach. This whale loved to play in the water, and all the other creatures in the sea would applaud the whale's games. Everyone was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Daisy. Daisy had a jolly day in her backyard, playing with her dolls. The sun was shining brightly and Daisy was so happy.

Suddenly, her mom came out of the house and called her. 'Daisy, come here! I have a surprise for you,' her mom said. Daisy was filled with excitement and quickly ran to her mom. 

'Here you go, darling. I bought this for you,' her mom said holding out a toy. Daisy was so excited, she thanked her mom for the surprise.

One day the sky was grey. It was starting to rain. It was so silly!

Once upon a time, a poor hedgehog named Jennifer lived deep in the woods. She was very sad because she wasn't rich like the other animals. One day, as Jennifer was walking, she found a sparkly gold coin. Then she heard a distant voice.

The sun was shining and the sky was blue. All the animals were playing in the meadow and the birds were singing.
